heading: INT. ORBITAL AGRICULTURE RING, SECTOR NINE - NIGHT CYCLE

units.text: INT. ORBITAL AGRICULTURE RING, SECTOR NINE - NIGHT CYCLE
Rows of hydroponic wheat curve up and over the ceiling, a green horizon bent into a loop.
Grow lights hum at a violet pitch.
A lone maintenance drone ticks along a rail.

CAPTAIN ISOLDE VANTERPOOL-NWOSU (50s, close-cropped silver hair, a mechanic's gloves tucked into her belt) crouches over an open irrigation panel while ENSIGN BARTHOLOMEW "BART" KOWALSKI-DIAZ (20s, freckled, a tool belt that sags on one hip) holds the flashlight and DR. ZAINAB HAKIMI-OSEI (40s, lab coat, a tablet she hasn't looked up from) paces the aisle between the rows, all three listening to the same faint knocking in the walls.

Down the far end, QUARTERMASTER FIONNUALA BRANAGH-SATO (30s, a clipboard under her arm) and a taciturn engineer called MERCATOR (60s, mechanical left hand, a cigar he never lights) stand at the lock, arguing in low voices about whose shift this was, while a nervous seed technician, PERPETUA "PERRY" OLUWASEUN (20s, a tray of seedlings hugged to her chest), hovers between the two groups.
Captain, it's coming from the north wall.
units.name: BART

units.text: It's coming from the wheat.
units.name: ISOLDE

units.text: Wheat doesn't knock.
units.name: ZAINAB

units.text: The knocking stops.
They all freeze.
Bart lowers the flashlight, Zainab lifts her head, Isolde stills with a wrench in her hand, and at the far end of the aisle Fionnuala and Mercator turn together.
Did you hear that?
units.name: FIONNUALA

units.text: Hear what?
units.name: MERCATOR

units.text: I told you the wheat was strange!
units.name: PERRY

units.text: The lights go out.
A beat of perfect dark, then emergency amber floods up from the floor.
The wheat rows rustle, though there is no wind.
Everyone to the hatch, now.
units.name: ISOLDE

units.text: They scatter.
Bart drops the flashlight and runs.
Zainab fumbles the tablet into her coat and follows.
Isolde backs away from the panel with the wrench raised.
Fionnuala drops the clipboard and Mercator grabs her sleeve, and together they stumble toward the lock as the north wall bulges inward, plates bending like wet paper.
What is that?
units.name: BART

units.text: Don't look at it!
units.name: ZAINAB

units.text: Too late.
Bart stops dead and stares.
Zainab catches his collar and hauls him around the corner, and Isolde slams the bulkhead shut behind all six of them, panting.
The knocking resumes on the other side, patient and rhythmic.
Mercator, for the first time, takes the cigar out of his mouth.
That's not wheat.
units.name: MERCATOR

units.text: No.
units.name: ISOLDE

units.text: Fionnuala starts to laugh, high and thin.
Nobody joins her.
